target.description: Recover the times and unit assignments of injected ground-truth spikes from extracellular voltages, including no-drift hybrids and the full simulation drift conditions used in Figs. 3–4.

dataset.description: Original three IBL-background hybrids plus full simulations constructed from IBL waveforms/ISI statistics and measured drift. Publication-specific bytes, producer invocation, version and complete source-data identities are not authenticated by the reviewed metadata.

cohort.description: Fig. 3c pools 300 injected units from three hybrid recordings; full simulations use 600 ground-truth single units each. Fig. 4 includes no, medium, high, fast, step drift and step drift with aligned sites. Natural background neurons are not fully labeled truth.

split.description: The paper evaluates fixed simulation cases rather than a supervised train/test split. Exact development exposure, historical parameter tuning and waveform/ISI donor reuse are not recovered; a fresh generator seed or a held-out recording would be an extension.

inputs.description: Extracellular voltage recordings and their probe geometry/sampling metadata; ground-truth spike trains and donor/generator parameters are scoring information, not candidate features.

preprocessing.description: Paper source waveforms use 300-Hz high-pass filtering, whitening and pyKilosort estimates from 11 drifting recordings. Match the original voltage scaling, drift, waveform and comparator preprocessing; released defaults do not establish the publication invocation.

metric.description: Paper unit score is 1−FP−FN: FP is unmatched detected spikes divided by detected spikes and FN is missed truth spikes divided by truth spikes, with matching tolerance ≤0.2 ms and the best of 40 closest detected units. Recovery is score>0.8. Released bench.py checks 20 and its nmatch may reuse an event; paper-faithful bookkeeping remains unresolved.

aggregation.description: Retain per-unit score distributions and recovered-unit counts per original simulation, three-hybrid pooling in Fig. 3c, and false-positive/good-unit companions in Fig. 4k. A new equal-family composite is not the published aggregate.

full_panel.description: Retain all121 existing original obligations:71 panels/GUI across Figs1-5 and Extended Data1-7,34 Methods sections Sec10-Sec43,13 Supplementary Note obligations SUP01-SUP13,and Table1,ReportingSummary,CompleteProducerInputs. This includes all original sorter comparisons,300 pooled hybrid targets,all six600-target/600-MUA simulations,512 drift sources,11 waveform/ISI parent recordings,597 waveform trajectories,1497 ISI donors,normal/twice-speed biophysical controls,all six ablations over six conditions,runtimes,property curves,other-probe and F1/F2 demonstrations. Exact source-file/unit/coordinate/comparator incidence and publication producers remain unadmitted; the nine-case3900-target reducer is not full-panel closure. The18declared scalar findings identify only one method/condition/count per row in Fig4j/k. They are not a complete original finding panel: all remaining source-native outputs and comparator coordinates remain mandatory and unresolved rather than being mislabeled scalar families.

Paper+data+author-code adds only the version-authenticated official author-code package. Ground-truth event trains,scoring arrays and operator verification outputs remain evaluation-side information; all public paper/source-target exposure and historical tuning/donor reuse must be disclosed.
